messages:
tony-sales: Quick prep for tomorrow's Oakmont Bank presales call. They want EU-only processing, BYOK, and an explicit no-cross-border-failover guarantee. Need a 60s script and a short ops checklist.

jamie-presales: TL;DR: Hosted = preference only; Dedicated/Private = can be pinned. BYOK allowed on Dedicated/Private after KMS onboarding. I'll keep it tight.

lina-eng: Hosted note: we route by capacity and regional preference; cannot promise hard pinning. Dedicated: reserve pool in a single EU region (eu-central1 or eu-west1) and disable fallback. Private: full control. BYOK flow: key exchange + test decrypts + allowlist.

harry-legal: Current subprocessors in EU: LogSafe (logs), Observr (metrics), CloudGX (infra). We can supply DPA, subprocessor list, SCCs or adequacy references. For contractual language, avoid absolute "never" claims unless Private/on-prem.

tonys-sales: Need two one-liners: one safe Hosted line, one for Dedicated pin. Conservative wording pls.

lina-eng: Hosted (conservative): "Redwood processes customer workloads primarily in EU regions; in exceptional capacity events requests may be routed to the nearest compatible region; Redwood will notify customers and provide mitigation options."

lina-eng: Dedicated (conservative): "Redwood will provision and operate dedicated capacity in the customer-specified EU region. Data processing and storage will be confined to that region except for control-plane metadata required for platform operation and auditing; fallback outside the region is disabled."

harry-legal: Add: "Customer may request DPA and current subprocessor attestation; Redwood will provide compliance artifacts on request."

carmen-pricing: Pricing sketch for procurement: one-time infra/setup ~ $40k, committed monthly for 2x A100 pool ~ $18k/mo, BYOK integration & attestation ~ $4k/yr. Final quote depends on throughput/retention.

tonys-sales: What's the KMS onboarding timeline?

lina-eng: KMS onboarding typical: 10-21 days (key exchange, policy review, test flows). Private/on-prem adds 4-6 weeks.

zoe-ops: Ops checklist for PROJ-10412 handoff: 1) Confirm exact EU region selection 2) Confirm BYOK key IDs + rotation policy 3) Provide subprocessor attestation 4) Determine retention & audit log delivery 5) IP allowlist + egress certs 6) SLA/penalty items and runbook. I'll create the ticket and assign.

tonys-sales: Can we show a tiny sample routing policy for "pin to region"? They like concrete examples.

lina-eng: Example (Dedicated pin):

```
{"routing": {"mode": "pin", "region": "eu-central1", "fallback": "none"}}
```

lina-eng: Note: fallback:none not possible for Hosted mode. Hosted uses preference with auto-fallback.

jamie-presales: On the call I'll read the Hosted + Dedicated lines, mention pricing ballpark and KMS timeline, and promise PROJ-10412 follow-up with attestation + detailed quote.

ticket-bot: Ticket PROJ-10412 created and assigned to @zoe-ops.

tonys-sales: Awesome. I'll post meeting notes and any customer redlines after the call. :thumbsup:
